items.title: Orrin Keepnews interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 7, 2002
items.q: the Leonard Bernstein, Comden and Green song

ctx.x: Well “Peace Piece” is literally what it always was identified as being. “Peace Piece” was an improvisation, it is true that what he was setting out to do was to create an introduction to a recording of “Some Other Time,” the Leonard Bernstein, Comden and Green song. He started messing around and found that gee, this was something very interesting in and of itself so that literally that was created at the record date. I mean nobody went in there with the intention — now actually the title was in existence but not…
Right. Did you have a feeling when it was over that this is going on the album, right away?
